identity.styleName: Flat Vector Pixel Halt at Dusk
identity.description: A minimalist flat-vector/pixel hybrid illustration of a station master standing on a platform track at dusk. Clean unfilled shapes, no outlines, heavily abstracted flat color regions, geometric architecture rendered as simple rectangles, triangles and trapezoids, with a restrained warm-cool dusk palette.

rendering.style: flat vector pixel art, low-detail poster illustration
rendering.shading: flat unshaded fills with minimal single-tone ambient occlusion, no gradients except subtle banded sky
rendering.outline: none, shapes separated by color contrast only
rendering.texture: clean flat planes, sparse pixel grain on track gravel

camera.perspective: flat side-on view, no vanishing point, layered flat planes for sky, station wall, and track foreground

plaster wall.appearance: matte flat mid-brown plane with faint darker banding

framed poster.appearance: lighter ochre panel with orange and dark navy mountain silhouettes inside a thin brown frame

rail steel.appearance: dark charcoal rails over grey gravel ballast

uniform cloth.appearance: dark navy jacket with mustard band and flat gold buttons

wood bench.appearance: simple horizontal brown slats on brown legs

character.silhouette: short compact blocky figure, wide flat cap brim, rectangular torso, stubby legs
character.proportions: roughly 3 heads tall, chunky square head, thick limbs, no neck taper
character.faceAbstraction: two black square eyes and a small black grid mouth on a pale white face, no other features
character.poseLanguage: static neutral front-facing stance, arms straight down at sides, feet together
character.clothing: dark navy uniform jacket with lighter navy shoulder blocks, mustard-yellow chest band with two gold buttons, dark navy cap with gold band and tiny square badge

environment.architecture: long flat brown station wall running horizontally, shallow dark triangle roof peak at left, thin tan trim strip along the top edge
environment.terrain: grey platform band in front of the wall, then a stone-textured track bed, dark rails further forward
environment.props: framed mountain poster on the wall, wooden bench, hanging small golden framed sign, three small square windows (blue, orange, brown), a round lamp on a thin pole, low sun disc rising above the wall on the right

animation.poseExaggeration: minimal, near-static character with 2-3 pixel bob or blink only

readability.silhouette: character reads clearly against the mid-brown wall via dark navy versus warm brown contrast
readability.contrast: strong value separation between dark character, warm mid wall, and cool blue sky
readability.gameplayScale: designed for small on-screen scale, character occupies under one fifth of frame height

composition.background: banded dusk sky, deep navy at the top fading to lighter blue
composition.midground: brown station facade with poster, bench, hanging sign, windows, lamp and low sun
composition.foreground: grey platform strip and stone-textured track with rails
composition.density: sparse, wide empty areas of flat color
composition.characterScale: small, centered slightly below middle, roughly one sixth of frame height
composition.objectScale: props sized in flat side view at consistent scale with the wall

lighting.direction: ambient frontal, no strong directional source
lighting.softness: hard-edged flat light, no soft falloff
